text: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was accepted to calculate the adsorption behavior of NBT on Co substrate. The universal force field in Material Studio was used to calculate the dynamics in the NVT ensemble and simulation time was 500 ps with a time step of 1 ps. section: Investigation of novel suppressor Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride on cobalt superconformal growth > 4. Conclusion
text: The suppressing effect of dye molecule Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride (NBT) on cobalt electrodeposition is investigated by LSV and EIS. DFT calculation and MD simulation is used to study the suppressing mechanism. Quantum chemical calculation, MD simulation and in situ Raman spectra confirms the strong adsorption effect of NBT on cobalt substrate. Besides, topology analysis and IRI analysis were applied to study the coordination effect between NBT and Co ^2 +. Synergistic sup pressing mechanism (adsorption effect and coordination effect) is proposed to demonstrate the influence of NBT.
